Here is my analysis of Voat finances for the month of June 2016

In the month of June Voat advertised on 19 of 30 days, resulting in a placement rate of approximately 64%. We know from Announcements that voat costs about $5000 per month to run. Now 12 days ago Puttitout did some maintenance which may have reduced costs here. Now we don't have any figures on how much it currently costs but we can make some models based on what we do know.

Revenues

We do know that Voat collected about $5000 from donations and $2000 from the teespring campaign. There was also the FPH donation drive which I will give a generous estimate of $3000. Additionally since the start of ads to the end of May I calculated that they collected at most $1375. In June they collected about $1045 from ads. This gives us a grand total of $12,420 in the bank.

Expenses

Given that the best figure we have is $5000 per month we will use this, but we know its been reduced recently. However,it's unlikely that these changes will have effected the June bill in any significant way, meaning that the costs for June would have been $5000 or close to it. Projecting a couple of scenarios forward with regard to the costs we can project a 10% reduction a 25% reduction and a 40% reduction in costs and look at how much time we have left if advertising stays the same and no other factors change.

Projections

Using $12,420 less the costs from June gives us $7,420 as the starting point.

Projected Voat Financials

Optimistic Middle Pessimistic
Cost Reduction 40% 25% 10%
Hosting cost 3000 3750 4500
Ad Revenue 1045 1045 1045
Burn Rate 1955 2705 3455
Time Remaining 113 Days 82 Days 64 Days

Based on these number, if nothing else changes Voat could have as little as 2 months left but definitely less than 4 months. If you think anything in this post is inaccurate I would be happy to change these numbers if you have better information or something I missed. As always I welcome the chance to be wrong. Also, please @atko @puttitout feel free to give us new information. These figures do not take into account random donations because they are impossible to predict. Also I have no doubt that voat will go into "donation drive" mode before things get too bad. However that will only work one or two more times.
